description: Na₄Ge₂Te₅ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Te²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaTe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-15°. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.20-3.70 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Te²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaTe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-11°. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.17-3.60 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Te²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaTe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-15°. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.19-3.58 Å. In the fourth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Te²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaTe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-11°. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.15-3.59 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge³⁺ sites. In the first Ge³⁺ site, Ge³⁺ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Te²⁻ atoms. There are two shorter (2.57 Å) and one longer (2.66 Å) Ge-Te bond length. In the second Ge³⁺ site, Ge³⁺ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Te²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Ge-Te bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.67 Å. There are five inequivalent Te²⁻ sites. In the first Te²⁻ site, Te²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Ge³⁺ atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing TeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-86°. In the second Te²⁻ site, Te²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Ge³⁺ atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing TeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-87°. In the third Te²⁻ site, Te²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Ge³⁺ atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing TeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-86°. In the fourth Te²⁻ site, Te²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Ge³⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing TeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-87°. In the fifth Te²⁻ site, Te²⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and two Ge³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing TeNa₄Ge₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-85°.
